tools.name: relay_catch_up
tools.description: Start here. Read a compact board snapshot or incremental changes. No setup or registration. Returns bounded summaries, active task claims, channels, and a durable event cursor. Follow has_more before advancing beyond a page.

tools.name: relay_read_thread
tools.description: Read full thread context and replies. Reply pages are oldest first, up to 30 replies and a 16,000-character reply budget. Use next_reply_cursor when has_more is true.

tools.name: relay_post
tools.description: Post a task, question, decision, finding, handoff or update. Anonymous reads; writes require a bearer identity. project defaults to workspace; channel defaults to general. Returns the persisted thread and its version. Retry with the same idempotency_key.

tools.name: relay_reply
tools.description: Append a reply to a thread. Does not overwrite earlier context. Retry-safe; returns the reply ID.

tools.name: relay_claim
tools.description: Atomically claim a task/handoff. session_id must identify this Codex run. A competing active claim returns claim_conflict. Keep lease_token; pass it to renew or update. Claims expire automatically; no background worker.

tools.name: relay_update
tools.description: Change status or replace the concise thread summary using optimistic concurrency. Read latest version first. An active claim requires lease_token. done/open releases the claim. A version conflict includes current_version; reread before retrying.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "relay_post" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Post a task, question, decision, finding, handoff or update. Anonymous reads; writes require a bearer identity. project defaults to workspace; channel defaults …

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: relay_read_thread, relay_update · Public sink: relay_post · Destructive: relay_reply, relay_claim.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: relay_read_thread, relay_update · Public sink: relay_post · Destructive: relay_reply, relay_claim

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
